en.html:
The Kubo of Horigoe, a leading figure in the shogunate. Political business, probably. Actually, somebody like her sitting at home relaxing—that was the strange part.

She had said she was staying in confinement over the Hachiman Shrine incident. But that also, swallow it whole and believe everything? Probably all maneuvering. Perhaps the maneuvering had produced results, and now she had to return to the center, Kamakura.

Chachamaru"Oh."
Kageaki"Your Excellency?"
Chachamaru"Udhar, udhar! Machines are coming out."
Chachamaru"Shokyo, that one?"
Kageaki"Yes. Aptima family, one look is enough."
Kageaki"...Perhaps a little too much the same."
Chachamaru"Nothing new I can see. Surely these fellows aren't taking that into next year's domestic races."
Kageaki"The Aptima is a masterpiece, yes... but now its time has passed, no?"
Chachamaru"Keeping the good stuff hidden? Fans have also come, kanjoos log. Give us something..."
Muramasa"This Aptima, wasn't it there in Kamakura also?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Muramasa"But it doesn't look the same."
Chachamaru"Where?"
Muramasa"That strange thing attached alongside the Gattari."
Chachamaru"The afterburner? ...Arre, you're right."
Kageaki"It's mounted in the middle. Midship layout. This... looks like it will change the machine's balance."
Chachamaru"Oho. Quietly they've done something interesting. Apun takes it back."
Kageaki"Belt drive also, possibly."
Chachamaru"Could be. That modification they've done before."

茶々丸「お」
景明「閣下？」
茶々丸「あっちあっち。 　騎体が出てきたよ」
茶々丸「ありゃ翔京かな？」
景明「そうですね。 　見るからにアプティマ系列」
景明「……そのもの過ぎる気がしますが」
茶々丸「工夫の跡が見えんね。 　まさか来年の国内戦をあれで行こうってん じゃあるまいに」
景明「アプティマは名作ですが…… 　流石に時代遅れかと」
茶々丸「出し惜しみかな？ 　ファンサービスってのがわかってねえ連中 だなぁ……」
村正「あぷてまって、鎌倉の時にもいたやつ？」
景明「そうだ」
村正「あれとは違うみたいだけど」
茶々丸「どこが？」
村正「合当理と一緒にくっついてる変なの」
茶々丸「補助推進器アフターバーナー？ 　……あ、ほんとだ」
景明「中心配置ミッドシップになっていますね。 　これは……騎体バランスに変化がありそう です」
茶々丸「地味に面白いことやってきたな。 　前言撤回」
景明「駆動方式もベルトかもしれません」
茶々丸「有り得るね。 　そんな改造、前にもやってたし」

Chachamaru"Huh? Tomii only. New team, come to make up the numbers, why bother with—"

Kageaki"Machine name—Infringer? This one may upset the whole event."
Chachamaru"Depends who's riding it. Could go anywhere with this. Ab maza aayega!"
Kageaki"Yes. Now it gets interesting."

茶々丸「何ィーーーッ!? 　ユーツ鋼ダブルデッキフレームにセンター デフ、ベルト駆動だとぉーーー!?」
景明「しかもあれはトルクスプリッター！」
茶々丸「完全装備かっ！ 　あの会社のどこにそんな開発能力があった んだ!?　あて、接着剤のいらない模型を作る だけが能かと思ってたよ!!」
景明「これは完全に予想外です」
村正「…………おぉーい…………」
景明「騎体名は――〝侵害者インフリンジャー〟？ 　今回の台風の目かもしれません」
茶々丸「騎手レーサー次第でどこまで行くかわからんね。 　面白くなってきたぞー」
景明「はい、実に」

en.html:
By then Muramasa had gone off in a full sulk and started spinning a web behind the circuit.

Haan. We had come to watch armored racing, and my own armor had decided to leave society and become a spider. Very fair. Two enthusiasts discussing metal, while the actual metal beside them was not even receiving an answer. Apparently this was how you lost your tsurugi: not in glorious combat, but by finding a more interesting suspension system.

Some pleading, some coaxing. No, Muramasa, that was not what I meant. Yes, Muramasa, I was listening. The second statement had very little support from the facts, so I did not lean on it too heavily.

Somehow I got her back to the seats in a better mood. The race had just started.

Armored racers shot off with a roar fit to split the air.

No mystery why Muramasa made that face.

Armor racing had its own atmosphere. Crowd everywhere, shouting, heat, wing barrels roaring from the track—

In one word, shor. Bloody noise.
If you were caught up in the race, that noise was excitement going straight into the veins. But take the race away and enjoy only the racket? Would that not simply get on your nerves?

I understood what was frustrating Muramasa. The Kubo could hardly be on my side. Yet every time she spoke, there I was, worrying and doubting. Naturally Muramasa was uneasy.

I knew it was strange also.
But Chachamaru Ashikaga's words always had something I could not ignore. Once heard, they would sit in my ears and refuse to leave.

en.html: She wasn't looking at me. She faced the circuit, where the staff were running about preparing for the next race. Still, I knew. Chachamaru Ashikaga was laughing. No sarcasm. No mockery. As if she had simply heard a very good joke. ...A low chuckle in her throat. I had to ask. What did she know? Ask now, and perhaps she would tell the truth. Somehow I felt that. I should ask.◆ ...Somehow I could not. Why? No, what why? I knew. If the truth was available and still I would not ask, then the truth was precisely what I did not want. Andar se I knew. From inside. Hear it, know it—and that would be the end.
en.text:
She wasn't looking at me. She faced the circuit, where the staff were running about preparing for the next race.

Still, I knew.

Chachamaru Ashikaga was laughing.
No sarcasm. No mockery.

As if she had simply heard a very good joke.
...A low chuckle in her throat.

I had to ask.
What did she know?

Ask now, and perhaps she would tell the truth.

Somehow I felt that.

I should ask.◆

...Somehow I could not.

Why?
No, what why? I knew.

If the truth was available and still I would not ask, then the truth was precisely what I did not want.

Andar se I knew. From inside.
Hear it, know it—and that would be the end.

ja.text:
少女は俺を見ていない。
　次のレースに備えるため会場スタッフが走り回る、
サーキットの方へ顔を向けている。

　それでもわかった。

　足利茶々丸は笑っている。
　皮肉にではなく。嘲るようでもなく。

　ただ、出来の良い諧謔・・・・・・・を聞いたおかしさを。
　……喉の奥でくつくつと、笑っている。

　俺は問い質さねばならなかった。
　何を知っているのか、と。

　今問えば、彼女は真実を口にするかもしれない。

　どうしてか、そう思う。

　問うべきなのだ。◆

　……どうしてか、それができない。

　どうして？
　いや、疑問など無い。

　真実を得られるとわかっていて、問いを口にしない
のは、真実が欲しくないから・・・・・・・・・・に決まっている。

　俺は直観しているのだ。
　それを聞き、それを知れば、最後おわりなのだと。
